import subprocess, json, sys

scenarios = ["normal","mixed","partial-zero","empty","unknown","fail-fast","cancelled","live"]
results = {}
for sc in scenarios:
    inp = "\n" if sc == "live" else None
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "/work/batch.py", sc], input=inp, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
    err_lines = [l for l in p.stderr.splitlines() if l.strip()]
    recs = [json.loads(l) for l in err_lines]
    seqs = [r["sequence"] for r in recs]
    ok_seq = seqs == list(range(len(seqs)))
    results[sc] = {
        "exit_code": p.returncode,
        "stdout": p.stdout,
        "n_records": len(recs),
        "seq_ok": ok_seq,
        "events": [r["event"] for r in recs],
    }
for k,v in results.items():
    print(k, v)

import subprocess, sys, time, os, fcntl

proc = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "/work/batch.py", "live"], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)

# make stderr non-blocking to read partial lines
fd = proc.stderr.fileno()
fl = fcntl.fcntl(fd, fcntl.F_GETFL)
fcntl.fcntl(fd, fcntl.F_SETFL, fl | os.O_NONBLOCK)

line = ""
deadline = time.time() + 5
got_progress = False
while time.time() < deadline:
    try:
        chunk = proc.stderr.read()
    except Exception:
        chunk = None
    if chunk:
        line += chunk
        if '"event": "progress"' in line or '"event":"progress"' in line.replace(" ", ""):
            got_progress = True
            break
    time.sleep(0.05)

still_running = proc.poll() is None
print("got_progress_while_running:", got_progress, "still_running_after_progress:", still_running)

proc.stdin.write("\n")
proc.stdin.flush()
out, err = proc.communicate(timeout=5)
print("final exit:", proc.returncode)
print("stdout:", out)
